review_text_raw: The pacing of the story is way too slow and the RNG is WAY too harsh. I do not want to replay the same level 8 times because of bad luck. Other than that, the game play becomes repetitive very quickly. Some really cool ideas, but really not worth it unless you just LOVE RNG puzzles.
